learner's story:
古代的时候，有一个才十二岁小男孩子叫孟子。有一天，孟子的妈妈找他的孩子，在当地的墓地找到了他跟别的孩子。妈妈认为他们拿东西，所以她问了，他们为什么拿水果？孟子说他们不是拿东西，而是给祖先水果祭拜。他说他老是来墓地请祖先给他建议。这个天他请他们给他建议怎么减轻他的家庭的负担。妈妈告诉他应该发现教育，然后找一个好的工作。回家以后孟子在家坐着，从早到晚一直学习，教育做完以后孟子考虑，不是当哲学家就是当商家。父母希望他当商家。但是，他从童年老是讨论重要的生活问题，很幸福。另外，孟子认为，当商人会害得他的价值观。难怪他决定成为哲学家，原来他想给别的人建议。

scenes.core: 孟子 offers sacrifices to ancestors at the graveyard
evidence: 孟子说他们不是拿东西，而是给祖先水果祭拜。
他老是来墓地请祖先给他建议。
details_left_out: 孟子 and 孟母 lived near the graveyard.

scenes.core: 孟母 decides to move away because the graveyard behaviour may harm 孟子
scenes.missing_part: 孟母 decides to move away from the graveyard neighbourhood because she worries that 孟子 copying sacrifices will affect him badly.

scenes.core: They move near the market and 孟子 copies buying and selling
scenes.missing_part: 孟母 moves the family to the market neighbourhood, where 孟子 imitates buying and selling every day.

scenes.core: 孟子 studies all day every day
evidence: 回家以后孟子在家坐着，从早到晚一直学习，教育做完以后孟子考虑，不是当哲学家就是当商家。
details_left_out: 孟母 moved the family from the market to a neighbourhood near a school.
The studying began after the move near the school.

scenes.core: 孟子 becomes a famous philosopher
scenes.missing_part: 孟子 becomes a famous philosopher, rather than only deciding to become one.

feedback: After 孟子 copies sacrifices at the graveyard, add that 孟母 worries this will affect him badly and decides to move away.
After the family leaves the graveyard, add that they move near the market and 孟子 copies buying and selling there every day.
At the end, after 孟子 studies every day, add that he becomes a famous philosopher.
